name: Roasted Potatoes
subtitle: Who needs fries? Or amp it up!
notes: Yummy with everything from hamburgers to pork roast. Note: You can vary Version 2 by first boiling your potatoes, then smashing (just squashing each potato down flat once–not mashing) them and adding the smashed potatoes to the cheese/butter mixture, and baking just until crisp.

items: Desired flavorings (for something simple, garlic salt; or fancy pepper, rosemary, etc.)
2 pounds small red or gold potatoes, washed and dried
½ cup fine grated parmesan cheese

steps.title: Season the potatoes (Version 1)
steps.body: Version 1: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Slice potatoes as desired. Pour a small amount (about **1 Tbsp olive oil**) and desired flavorings (for something simple, use garlic salt, or get creative and add fancy pepper, rosemary, etc.).

steps.title: Bake (Version 1)
steps.body: Version 1: Place flat on a cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes, turning once at 10 minutes. Serve immediately.

steps.title: Microwave option (Version 1)
steps.body: Version 1: You can also microwave for 5 minutes or until soft prior to baking to improve the internal texture.

steps.title: Melt the butter (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Place in 13×9-inch pan **½ cup butter**. Place pan in oven and turn to 400°F to preheat. When butter is bubbly, remove pan and set aside.

steps.title: Score the potatoes (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Meanwhile, halve and score, by making a crosshatch pattern about ⅛” deep: **2 pounds small red or gold potatoes**, washed and dried.

steps.title: Mix the coating (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: In a small bowl, mix together **½ cup fine grated parmesan cheese**, **1½ Tbsp Italian herb seasoning**, **½ tsp garlic powder**, **1 tsp salt** and **½ tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Nestle the potatoes (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Add to melted butter in the pan and mix well, then nestle the potatoes cut side down into the cheese and butter mixture.

steps.title: Brush and sprinkle (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Brush and sprinkle the tops of the potatoes with **1 Tbsp parmesan**, olive oil, salt & pepper.

steps.title: Bake (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Place pan in oven and bake uncovered for 35–40 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender with a crispy crust.

steps.title: Rest and top (Version 2)
steps.body: Version 2: Allow to cool for 5–10 minutes to allow cheese to set. Top with parsley or chives if you like.

yields: Version 2 (2 lb potatoes) serves 4–6; Version 1 is to taste (estimated)
